question:
What is the median of the following data?

76, 35, 42, 49, 95, 21, 68, 41, 20, 27, 17
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the given data numbers in ascending order.

Sorted data: 17, 20, 21, 27, 35, 41, 42, 49, 68, 76, 95

For an odd number of terms (n = 11), the median is exactly the middle term.

Middle term = (11 + 1) ÷ 2 = 6th term, which is 41.

**∴ The correct answer is 41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 76, 35, 42, 49, 95, 21, 68, 41, 20, 27, 17

Total number of observations (n) = 11

**Formula Used:**

If n is odd, Median = Value of the [(n + 1) ÷ 2]th observation
